name: comp-474
title: Vertical Key Value Table
blurb: Table displayed in a key-value format, one per row, vertically stacked.
description: A table variant where each row shows a key (label) and its value, styled like a definition list.
use_when: Displaying sparse or hierarchical key-value data.
a11y: Structure should use <dt> and <dd> or similar semantic pairing.
